roleContext.jobDescription: Our payment reconciliation service matches card-scheme settlement files against ledger entries for a mid-sized acquirer. The Data Analytics Engineer builds and maintains the reconciliation data pipelines, investigates unmatched items with the finance operations team, and is expected to deliver a measurable reduction in the unmatched-item backlog against a documented baseline. The role reports to the head of finance engineering and works closely with the settlement operations and compliance teams.

requirements.text: Builds and maintains SQL/Python pipelines that load card-scheme settlement files and ledger extracts into the reconciliation warehouse.
Investigates unmatched settlement items with finance operations and documents root causes in the exception log.
Delivers a measurable reduction in the unmatched-item backlog, reported against a documented baseline and time window.
Coordinates pipeline changes with the settlement operations and compliance teams during the monthly change window and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents data lineage, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each pipeline release.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Data Analytics Engineer, Payment Reconciliation

## Experience

- Built the nightly loader that ingests Visa and Mastercard settlement files (TC57/T112) and the general-ledger extract into the reconciliation warehouse on Snowflake, using dbt models and a Python pre-validation step for file checksums.
- Worked the daily unmatched-item queue with two finance operations analysts, tracing each exception to fee mismatches, timing differences or duplicate captures, and recorded the root cause and resolution in the shared exception log.
- Presented pipeline changes at the monthly change-window review with settlement operations and compliance; my part covered the loader and the matching keys, while approval of the go-live date stayed with the finance engineering lead.
- Wrote the lineage notes for the matching model, listing the source files, the transformation steps and the two known limitations (partial refunds and multi-currency fees) that still needed manual review.
- Responsibilities included loader maintenance, exception investigation and release documentation for the reconciliation warehouse over roughly eighteen months in the finance engineering team.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised exception-log extract with the root-cause taxonomy (fee mismatch, timing, duplicate capture, unknown) and the SQL used to classify unmatched items; the extract keeps the warehouse query history as a verification trail.
